$comment: Central plan contract. Limits are design assumptions, not validated pricing. Device, routine and layout limits are enforced by cloud-api (plans.py) and carried in the entitlement assertion; the assertion's plan claim is 'pro' for every paid plan (Pro and Pro Plus share every PC-facing limit). manual_command_rate_limit applies per controller to non-coalescable actions; coalescable_command_rate_limit applies to actions that declare `coalesce` (sliders): the PWA throttles sliders to one command per 250 ms plus the final value on release. input_rate_limit applies per controller to signed input_batch frames (manual touchpad/keyboard, rules.input_sessions); identical for every plan because Free has the same input responsiveness as Pro. AI assistant (docs/design/assistant.md; read by cloud-api only): one AI request is one charged assistant turn. ai_window is the rolling allowance that starts at the first request when no window is open and lasts `hours`; ai_week likewise lasts `days`; a request needs room in both. ai_taste_requests is a one-time allowance that never renews (Free). ai_topup_allowed: the plan may buy pricing_defaults.topup and spend its balance; the balance never expires and is kept across plan changes. ai_cost_cap_cents_per_week is an internal per-account backstop in US cents on the metered provider cost per weekly window (unknown-cost turns count against it); ai_turn_rate_limit is the per-account token bucket for POST /v1/assistant/turn. Everyday commands the phone understands by itself never count on any plan. Whether AI is offered at all is a server setting (DOME_AI_ENABLED); these allowances describe the plan, not availability.

pricing_defaults.$comment: Display amounts for the pricing page, the Billing page and GET /v1/plans. The amounts charged are those of the Stripe price objects named by DOME_STRIPE_PRICE_*; the founder keeps both equal (docs/LAUNCH_SETUP.md 'Stripe'). US dollars; the Stripe prices are tax-inclusive (founder decision 2026-10-20), so any sales tax is part of the amount, never added to it.

downgrade_policy.$comment: On a downgrade the customer picks which PCs and phones stay enabled within the window (GET/PUT /v1/account/plan-selection); otherwise the most recently seen are kept. Nothing is deleted. Revocation and emergency stop work for every paired device regardless of plan.
